name: German Rentenversicherungsnummer VKVV §4 Checksum
description: Validates German social security numbers (Rentenversicherungsnummer) using the VKVV §4 algorithm. The letter at position 9 is replaced by its 2-digit ordinal (A=01..Z=26), yielding 12 effective digits. Weights [2,1,2,5,7,1,2,1,2,1,2,1] are applied; each product's cross-sum (Quersumme) is summed; result mod 10 must equal the check digit at position 12.
